props.gloss_en: one who comes to accept the matters of chaverut must accept before three chaverim
the first tanna: even a Torah scholar must accept before three chaverim
the first tanna: an elder who sits in the yeshiva need not accept before three chaverim
for he already accepted it upon himself from the time he sat [in the yeshiva]
Abba Shaul: even a Torah scholar need not accept before three chaverim
Abba Shaul: and not only that, but others accept [chaverut] before him
R' Yochanan: this mishna was taught in the days of the son of R' Chanina ben Antigonus

the story: R' Yehuda and R' Yosei were in doubt about a matter of purities; the Sages sent [emissaries] to the son of R' Chanina ben Antigonus to examine it; they found him carrying taharot; he seated Sages of his own beside them, and stood to examine it
R' Yehuda: this one's father degraded Torah scholars, and he too degrades Torah scholars
R' Yosei: let the elder's honour rest in its place; rather, from the day the Temple was destroyed the priests adopted a higher standard for themselves, that they do not hand taharot to every person
